with Lord Byron’ (Mary’s ‘Note on the Poems of 1816’, 1839 iii 35). As Gavin de Beer has estab-
lished (SC iv 690–701), that expedition took place 22–30 June 1816, so the MS date on Harvard
Nbk 2 (see below), ‘Switzerland June — 1816’, may only be that of the original conception.

revealed only in December 1976 after its discovery in a deposit-box at the Pall Mall branch of
